'''Gaber Rollobad''' was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who owned the [[YT-1210 light freighter/Legends|YT-1210 light freighter]] ''[[Boolarg]]''.

==Biography==
On a gun-run, Rollobad was shot down over [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] by the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Shrike (Star Destroyer)|''Shrike'']] and crashed his [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] near the ''Boolarg''. He attempted to enlist the aid of freelancers to recover the weapons shipment, which was hidden in a compartment onboard his vessel, but was caught by Imperial officials in the process.<ref name="CCW" />
